review_candidates.title: Senior Recruiter, Expansion
review_candidates.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How You'll Help Us Achieve It Wave is entering new markets every year and when we launch, the first hires have to be right, and they have to happen before there is an office, an HR team, a salary benchmark, or a single person on the ground who knows the local talent market. This role exists to solve that. You'll be a deployable recruiter on our expansion recruiting team, sent into new markets ahead of launch to do the groundwork that can't be done remotely, and to stay long enough to hand a working hiring engine to the permanent team. We've proven this model works. What we need now is someone who can do it in francophone markets. In this role, you’ll; Deploy into new markets from roughly a month before launch, and own hiring on the ground through the critical early months. Build the talent map from scratch: who exists in this market, where they work, what they earn, what will move them, and which profiles simply don't exist locally and will need to come from elsewhere. Establish realistic compensation benchmarks for a market with no reliable salary data, and feed those back so our offers land rather than get laughed at. Own full-cycle recruitment for the first cohort of hires, weighted heavily toward leadership and business-critical roles that shape everything after them. Cover the gap before People Ops arrives: onboarding the first hires, sorting practicalities alongside the launch team, and acting as the People function in-country until the permanent hire is in post. Hire and hand over to your own replacement, then set them up to succeed without you. Keep Greenhouse clean and current in conditions that make it tempting not to, so that pipeline health and funnel data stay usable from anywhere. Carry the Wave hiring bar into markets where nobody knows us yet, and be the first credible face of Wave to senior candidates in that country. Capture what you learn each launch: what worked, what the market did, what we'd do differently so market three is faster than market one. We support working parents with generous parental leave (26 weeks for mothers, 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work. We help you live your fullest life now and we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes. Full professional fluency in French and English, including negotiating comp and handling difficult conversations in both. Experience recruiting in a market you did not previously know, where you had to build the map yourself rather than work an existing network. Strong experience hiring for both field and office roles. Genuine willingness and ability to live and work away from home for months at a time, repeatedly. High autonomy in ambiguous conditions, often as the only recruiter in the country. You might be a good fit if you Want a job that moves. Handle the practical realities of frequent relocation well: visas, logistics, unfamiliar cities, working from somewhere that isn't an office yet. La mission couverte par ce post-doctorat vise à répondre à ces défis à travers une approche technique, sociale et scientifique par la conception d’un système énergétique optimisé à trois niveaux : Un système solaire optimisé pour l’éclairage rural; L’alimentation en énergie des écoles en zones rurales de Madagascar; Un système communautaire d’énergie partagée.
